<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Rose believes in true love and leprechauns. Her flatmate Cassie is engaged in a fervent struggle against patriarchal oppression. Across London, Mark believes in the power of marketing. His flatmate Tim Muffin is engaged in a struggle against life.</span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">In a city where Gumtree feels like your closest friend, looking for the right person can lead you all the wrong places. </span></p>
<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Penelope Skinner’s </span><em><span class="x_s1">Eigengrau</span></em><span class="x_s2"> premiered at the Bush Theatre, London, in March 2010.</span></p>

<p class="x_p1"><span class="x_s2">Neila Stephens and Tom Zachar will be returning in Eigengrau, alongside the brilliant Hannah Noël Brennan and Joe Urquhart. </span></p>
